summary: Round 1 had no findings, so nothing carried over. Since round 1 (commit 3a1e98c), the code changes are test-only, with no src changes. e2e/hand-records.spec.ts adds a valid decisions entry to the oldRecord fixture. The fixture uses fixed literals with no secrets or personal data. tests/table/decision-record.test.ts adds rejection cases: explanation over 2000 characters, opponentBasis text that is empty or over 200 characters, a non-enum alternative, a mismatched recommended seat, and decision amounts that don't match the user's actions. These tests run the round-1 length and cross-check bounds at trust boundary 1 (stored IndexedDB records), so they make that boundary better tested. They also add a check that decisionRecord output shares no references with its input. Removing the not.toBe(advice.move) assertion only drops an identity check on the recommendation object; it has no security impact, because the new mutation test covers the action and legal-action aliasing paths. No new dependencies, secrets, sinks or trust boundaries.
